parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: You can either ____ in this form now and hand it back to me, or you can do everything online at home if you prefer.
As many people are choosing not to have children nowadays, the ____ of my country has decreased since the start of this century.
They need to ____ this street. It’s so narrow. It’s almost impossible to pass a car coming the other way.
If we want to eat in this restaurant, we’ll have to stand in the ____ , and it’s really long. Can’t we go somewhere else?
On the shortest day of the year in London, sunrise is at 8:04 and ____ is at 15:53.
Solomon encouraged his sons ____ to the industrial north of the country to find work.
I have no idea ____ Charles knew where all the money was, but he knew.
Which do you consider ____ the most important: health, money or love?
The decision to drive Michael to the hospital was an easy one to ____ ; he looked terrible!
Excuse me. Are you ____ charge of those children? They’re running around the restaurant and making a terrible noise.
Victor told me he’d be late, but I expect ____ pretty soon.
The children ____ turns to see who could say the English alphabet the fastest!
We got to the station ____ time to have a coffee before walking to the platform for our train.
Eduardo has offered me £100 ____ exchange for helping him to move house.
I’m sorry but this plan doesn’t ____ sense. We need to go away and think about it more.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: I wouldn’t say my ankle was painful, but it feels rather oddly when I start running.
I don’t know which staff member was last to leave the store yesterday, but who it was failed to lock the main door.
The sea was rough yesterday, and a few passengers were seasick. However, the sea’s very smooth now, so I don’t think we’ll have the same problem today.
If you really don’t want to visit Uncle Fred, than you don’t have to come with us. You can stay here with your sister if you prefer.
I can’t wait till all these exams are over. They get so stressing!
Of course I can roast a chicken. You should have more faith by my cooking skills!
When’s your boyfriend arriving? I can’t wait for meeting him!
Might Paula use to live in Spain before she moved to England? She speaks the language so well.
Agata had spent about ten minutes trying to open the ketchup bottle but couldn’t.
This summer holiday, you’re happy to visit somewhere you’ve been to before, don’t you?

parts.text: If someone hit a policeman, they’d be arrested. Another word for midday is noon. Two other words for “ill” are “sick” and “unwell”. We can use rope for climbing mountains. The opposites of “overcook” and “overpay” are “undercook” and “underpay”. Mud is a mixture of earth and water. Another name for a chemist’s is a pharmacy. A thousand grams make a kilogram. An island is a piece of land completely surrounded by water. A fortnight consists of fourteen days. We call the fatty part of fresh milk the cream. Brian stood up, tried to walk to the door, and immediately fell over!

teacher.1: What are the three forms of “choose”?
teacher.4: What are the three forms of “blow”?
teacher.5: What kind of matter are books made of?
teacher.6: Which modal is the only exception to this rule?
teacher.7: What do we call the words “who”, “which” and “that”?
teacher.8: What are the three forms of “fly”?
teacher.9: What are the three forms of “fight”?
teacher.10: What does the expression “every now and again” mean?

1: I wouldn’t say my ankle was painful, but it feels rather odd when I start running.
2: I don’t know which staff member was last to leave the store yesterday, but whoever it was failed to lock the main door.
3: The sea was rough yesterday, and a few passengers were seasick. However, the sea’s very calm now, so I don’t think we’ll have the same problem today.
4: If you really don’t want to visit Uncle Fred, then you don’t have to come with us. You can stay here with your sister if you prefer.
5: I can’t wait till all these exams are over. They get so stressful!
6: Of course I can roast a chicken. You should have more faith in my cooking skills!
7: When’s your boyfriend arriving? I can’t wait to meet him!
8: Did Paula use to live in Spain before she moved to England? She speaks the language so well.
9: Agata spent about ten minutes trying to open the ketchup bottle but couldn’t.
10: This summer holiday, you’re happy to visit somewhere you’ve been to before, aren’t you?
